title: Gideon and the Vector
author: Wendell Winterbourne
blurb: Ansel Ishikawa, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
